meta.title: Cursor Agent: Process rules in parallel
meta.body_summary: Introduce parallel batch processing (size 3) in ProcessRules handleRunAll to reduce sequential email processing time in inbox-zero.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added parallel batch processing; coderabbitai suggested error-tolerant batching; elie222 adopted a queue-based variant and merged quickly without benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 121 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance PR with a straightforward concurrency improvement, consistent with the quick merge.

review_details.concern_detail: coderabbitai inline review suggested wrapping each onRun call in try/catch to isolate failures and hoist BATCH_SIZE constant to avoid re-declaration.
review_details.performance_claim: Parallel batch processing of messages (batch size 3) reduces total processing time compared to sequential iteration.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Concurrency refactor in a Next.js handler; agent proposed parallel Promise.all, reviewer requested error isolation, and maintainer later adopted a queue-based approach. No evidence boundary exceeded.

detection_detail.code_reading: coderabbitai bot reviewed the batch processing logic and suggested error isolation improvements; maintainer adopted the concept in a later queue-based commit.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing data or benchmark; only a narrative performance claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer committed a queue-based refactor and error handling improvements after the initial parallel batch approach, all within the same PR before merge.

core_change_summary.description: In ProcessRules.tsx, replaced sequential for-loop in handleRunAll with concurrency-controlled processing: pre-filter messages, then process in parallel batches of 3 using Promise.all, with error handling; later refactored to a queue-based parallel approach.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merging main brought version bump and unrelated BulkRunRules/TestCustomEmailForm changes inherited from main.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (6fd51bf): introduced parallel batch processing with BATCH_SIZE=3 and pre-filtering.
Second agent commit (398cf06): added error handling improvements.
Maintainer commit (130d291): replaced batch loop with a queue-based parallel approach.

review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer later adopted a queue-based approach that likely incorporates similar error isolation.
